name: rosetta-strip-control-codes-and-extended-characters-from-a-string
code:
use default

strip_control(text: string) -> string =>
    string(
        text
            |> filter(c => cast int(c) >= 32 /\ cast int(c) != 127)
            |> collect_array())

strip_control_and_extended(text: string) -> string =>
    string(
        text
            |> filter(c => cast int(c) >= 32 /\ cast int(c) <= 126)
            |> collect_array())

let sample = "Hello\tWorldCafé"

write_line("original: {sample}")
write_line("control stripped: {strip_control(sample)}")
write_line(
    "control and extended stripped: {strip_control_and_extended(sample)}")
